_comment: Milestone manifest for scripts/bench/perf-table.py. One object per production milestone, in chronological order. All file names are basenames under bench-results/. See scripts/bench/README-perf-table.md.

milestones.label: FP8 + MTP k=3
milestones.recipe: zai-org FP8 weights, KV fp8_e4m3, MTP drafter k=3, vLLM v8 image
milestones.comment: The code phase did not exist yet.

milestones.label: NVFP4 + DFlash2 k=7
milestones.recipe: NVFP4 weights, DFlash2 drafter k=7 (three-way comparison lane)
milestones.comment: Lane dropped after the three-way comparison; kept for context only.

milestones.label: EXL3 + DFlash2 k=7
milestones.recipe: EXL3 weights, DFlash2 drafter k=7 (three-way comparison lane)
milestones.comment: Lane dropped after the three-way comparison; kept for context only.

milestones.label: FP8 + DFlash2 k=7
milestones.recipe: FP8 weights, DFlash2 drafter k=7, async scheduling off, vLLM v11 image
milestones.comment: Shipped for a few hours, then reversed by the k=3 window the same afternoon.

milestones.label: FP8 + DFlash2 k=3 (START)
milestones.recipe: FP8 weights, DFlash2 drafter k=3, async scheduling off, vLLM v11 image
milestones.comment: Starting point of the 2026-09-03/04 tuning campaign.

milestones.label: W1 warm-up reference
milestones.recipe: Same engine as the 09-02 k=3 recipe, context lowered to 262144x6, NCCL INFO on
milestones.comment: Warm-up methodology changed here: from W1 on, one pass after boot is always discarded. The manual code/prose runs of this window were not written with --out.

milestones.label: Host iommu.passthrough=1
milestones.recipe: Triton MoE recipe plus iommu.passthrough=1 on all four hosts
milestones.comment: Prefill-30k, code and prose come from the '-b' repeat set: the pass itself contains one slow prefill run taken right after the warm-up.

milestones.label: Hybrid GB10 MoE config (production confirmation)
milestones.recipe: Passthrough recipe plus the hybrid GB10-tuned MoE config JSON
milestones.comment: The baseline docs/gate.md and run_ab.sh BASE_* currently declare.

milestones.label: Night final (same recipe, third boot)
milestones.recipe: Hybrid MoE recipe, unchanged; third boot of the night
milestones.comment: Same recipe as the hybrid confirmation: the gap to it is the boot-to-boot band.

milestones.label: Adaptive draft length v1 (overlay boot)
milestones.recipe: Hybrid MoE recipe plus adaptive k v1: SPEC_TOKENS=5, per-request k in {3,5}
milestones.comment: Measured on the experiment overlay, before promotion. Pass 1's 100k prefill median contains one isolated slow run.

milestones.label: Adaptive draft length v1 (production)
milestones.recipe: Adaptive k v1 promoted to cluster.env (2026-09-04 12:05)
milestones.comment: Confirmation passes on the promoted cluster.env after the 13:18 autostart boot (two run_ab passes 13:19 and 13:25, code/prose x3 each). Read above the 08:31 overlay boot: same recipe, boot-to-boot band.
